    static long[][] nCr;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long countWays(int fatsLeft, int slimsLeft, int ridesLeft, boolean boatAtStart)
    {
        if(fatsLeft==0 && slimsLeft==0 && ridesLeft==0)
            return 1;
        if(ridesLeft==0)
            return 0;
        if(dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatAtStart?0:1] != -1)
            return dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatAtStart?0:1];

        long totalWays=0;
        if(boatAtStart)
        {
            for(int i=0; i<=fatsLeft; i++)
                for(int j=0; j<=slimsLeft; j++)
                    if(i + j > 0 && 2*i + j <= capacity)
                        totalWays = (totalWays + (nCr[fatsLeft][i] * nCr[slimsLeft][j] % MOD * countWays(fatsLeft - i, slimsLeft - j, ridesLeft - 1, false)) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        else
        {
            for(int i=0; i<=fats - fatsLeft; i++)
                for(int j=0; j<=slims - slimsLeft; j++)
                    if(i + j > 0 && 2*i + j <= capacity)
                        totalWays = (totalWays + (nCr[fats - fatsLeft][i] * nCr[slims - slimsLeft][j] % MOD * countWays(fatsLeft + i, slimsLeft + j, ridesLeft - 1, true)) % MOD) % MOD;
        }

        return dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatAtStart?0:1] = totalWays;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
    {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        capacity = sc.nextInt() / 50;
        fats=0; slims=0;
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++)
            if(sc.nextInt() == 100)
                fats++;
            else
                slims++;
        dp = new long[fats+1][slims+1][201][2];
        for(int i=0; i<=fats; i++)
            for(int j=0; j<=slims; j++)
                for(int k=0; k<=200; k++)
                    dp[i][j][k][0] = dp[i][j][k][1] = -1;
        nCr = new long[51][51];
        nCr[0][0]=1;
        for(int i=1; i<=50; i++)
            for(int j=0; j<=i; j++)
                nCr[i][j] = (factorial(i) * modInverse((factorial(i - j)* factorial(j)) % MOD, MOD)) % MOD;

        for(int r=1; r<=200; r++)
        {
            long ways = countWays(fats, slims, r, true);

                System.out.println(r);
                System.out.println(ways);
                sc.close();
                System.exit(0);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(-1);
        System.out.println(0);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long factorial(int num)
    {
        long res=1;
        for(int i=2; i<=num; i++)
            res=(res*i)%MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static long modInverse(long a, int m)
    {
        return powm(a, m-2, m);
    }

    static long powm(long base, int exp, int mod)
    {
        long result=1;
        long b=base;
        int e=exp;
        while(e>0)
        {
            if((e & 1) == 1)
                result=(result * b) % mod;
            b=(b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
